use_cases: Displaying hero images in abstract organic shapes for landing pages
Creating splash art visual effects for creative portfolios
Showcasing media content with unique clipping masks in hero sections
Adding visual interest to image galleries with custom clip paths
Replacing standard rectangular images with artistic masked shapes
ai_summary: A media component that uses SVG clip-paths to mask images and videos into abstract, organic splash-art shapes. Supports customizable clip path definitions and renders media items with creative masking effects. Ideal for hero sections, creative portfolios, and any visual showcase requiring distinctive image presentation beyond standard rectangles.
